cwe_content.cwe: CWE-444,Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests ('HTTP Request/Response Smuggling')

candidate.Reason: The code does not properly terminate the HTTP request header context in all cases. While it does terminate the context in the else branch via bodyEndHandler, it doesn't handle context termination when the context is already active (in the if branch). This could lead to inconsistent interpretation of HTTP requests.
